name: Colors and Numbers
description:
Coloring fun cartoons, mandalas or other joyful pictures. Have a relaxing and joyful experience with Colors and Numbers by coloring pictures in a simple and easy way!

Colors and Numbers is a digital coloring book where you color different pictures by choosing the right numbered color and touch the corresponding numbered section on the picture. Coloring has never been easier ! 

Features :
- Different Themes
- Simple way of coloring
